_widening_note: v2 widens start_n from low=2,high=8 to low=2,high=16 (step=1) and explicitly includes the untouched second knob min_chunk at its declared validated range 1..4. Supported by the bound environment: tools/experiment_loop/ios_env/minimizer.py:57-62 declare both knobs, and _param_ddmin accepts any start_n >= 2 (minimizer.py:28: n = max(2, start_n)) with n capped at len(data) in the doubling step (minimizer.py:41-43), so start_n up to 16 is valid for the ~56-byte padded crash seeds; min_chunk is consumed as a floor (minimizer.py:30: chunk = max(min_chunk, len(data) // n)) and 1..4 is its validated declared domain. min_chunk needs no env edit - it was already declared; only start_n high=8 -> high=16 in minimizer.py:58 activates the widening. The padding knob is deliberately NOT exposed (minimizer.py:52-55 comment) and stays excluded. Id bumped v1->v2 because Goal.stable_id ignores knob ranges and the declared id overrides it anyway, so resuming under -v1 would keep the saturated 'start_n=7 optimal' lesson and suppress exploration of the opened 9..16 region.
objective: Minimize crash-inducing testcases while preserving deterministic reproduction
